findings.current:
A red mist rose with the breath I exhaled.

It was a long, slow breath—so long that one might mistake it for the breath of someone who had stopped breathing altogether. It was also a secret technique I had learned from my Master long ago.
findings.defect: The draft changes the third-person subject to the first-person narrator, making Jin Taekyung appear to perform Go Jun’s breathing technique. It also misconstrues the slow breathing as the breath of someone who has stopped breathing.
findings.rationale: The surrounding scene identifies Go Jun as the person breathing and recalling what his Master taught him; the Korean says the breathing was slow enough to make him seem not to breathe.
findings.replacement:
A red mist rose with his exhaled breath.

It was a long, slow breath—so long and slow that one might mistake him for not breathing at all. It was also a secret technique he had learned from his Master long ago.
findings.source:
내뱉는 숨을 따라 붉은 안개가 피어오른다.

그것은 숨을 쉬지 않는다고 착각할 만큼 길고 느린 호흡이었다. 아주 오래전, 스승으로부터 배운 비기(祕器)이기도 했다.

findings.current: My eyes grew hot. My heart, which had not wavered even once while breaking through a 120-story skyscraper and more than a thousand enemies, began to churn.
findings.defect: The draft changes an approximate quantity of around one thousand enemies into more than one thousand.
findings.rationale: 천여 명 means approximately or a little over one thousand, not definitively more than one thousand.
findings.replacement: My eyes grew hot. My heart, which had not wavered even once while breaking through a 120-story skyscraper and around a thousand enemies, began to churn.
findings.source: 눈가가 뜨겁게 달아오른다. 120층에 달하는 마천루(摩天樓)와 천여 명의 적들을 돌파하며 단 한 번도 흔들리지 않았던 마음이 격동한다.

findings.current: My dantian, which had been continuously consuming internal energy, was half empty. But that was enough.
findings.defect: The draft makes the dantian itself the agent consuming internal energy rather than describing it as depleted because Taekyung has continuously expended that energy.
findings.rationale: The source explains the mechanical cause of the dantian’s depleted state: ongoing expenditure of internal energy.
findings.replacement: My dantian was half empty from the internal energy I had continuously expended. But that was enough.
findings.source: 끊임없이 공력을 소모한 단전은 반쯤 비어 있었으나 그것만으로도 충분했다.

findings.current: When I stood up, rubble and pieces of marble fell from the building.
findings.defect: The draft adds an incorrect point of origin, saying the debris fell from the building rather than simply falling as Taekyung rose from the crater.
findings.rationale: The Korean does not say the debris falls from the building; it falls in direct response to Taekyung getting up.
findings.replacement: As I rose, rubble and pieces of marble tumbled down.
findings.source: 몸을 일으키자 건물의 잔해와 대리석 조각이 떨어진다.

findings.current:
But……

The moment I heard the hatred in his voice.
findings.defect: Go Jun’s repeated spoken call of Jin Taekyung’s name is omitted from the second viewpoint, removing the deliberate echo that triggers Taekyung’s reaction.
findings.rationale: The source repeats the name after the viewpoint shift before describing Taekyung hearing the hatred in Go Jun’s voice.
findings.replacement:
But……

“Jin Taekyung.”

The moment I heard the hatred in his voice.
findings.source:
하지만…….

“진태경.”

증오가 담긴 놈의 목소리를 듣는 순간.

findings.defect: The draft omits the child’s audible stammer, weakening his startled and deferential response.
findings.rationale: The repeated 저 explicitly marks hesitation and surprise.

findings.current: Not a chance, you fucking moron.
findings.defect: The translation loses the abrupt sarcastic shift into polite speech marked by 요, flattening the line’s comic register contrast.
findings.rationale: 천만에요 uses a conspicuously polite ending immediately before the insult; the clash of registers is intentional.

summary: The draft contains one critical viewpoint error, several altered or omitted details, and losses of repetition, hesitation, and a deliberate register shift.
